title: Case 010: Solar panel readings photo request
initial_request: Solar panel readings every 3 months w photo needed from Ts for LL. Next due Mid June.
overview: Northbridge Lettings requested a clear photo of the tenant’s solar panel readings for the property. After follow-ups, the tenant agreed to send a photo, which was forwarded to the landlord. The landlord confirmed receipt and said the next readings would be needed on 15th September.
outcome: The solar panel readings photo was sent to the landlord, who confirmed receiving it and said the next readings would be needed on 15th September.
